title: Zesty Greek Lentil Baklava
description: A tangy and airy Greek-inspired baklava made with spiced lentils, dashi, and binchotan charcoal, perfect for a hangover cure.

ingredients.name: cooked red lentils
ingredients.notes: soaked 2 hours, drained, then cooked until soft

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly oil a 20 cm square baking dish.
Prepare the lentil filling by combining cooked lentils, rehydrated dashi, binchotan charcoal powder, lemon zest, lemon juice, and salt; stir until fragrant.
In a saucepan, dissolve sugar in water over medium heat until syrup forms, then let cool slightly.
Layer two sheets of phyllo in the baking dish, brushing each sheet with olive oil; repeat until six sheets are layered.

Spread a thin layer of the lentil mixture over the phyllo, then drizzle with half the sugar syrup; repeat the layering with phyllo, lentil, and syrup until all ingredients are used, ending with a sheet of phyllo on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pastry is crisp.
While the baklava rests for 5 minutes, combine the remaining sugar syrup with ground cinnamon; pour over the still-hot baklava to create a caramel glaze.
Allow the baklava to cool completely in the dish, then cut into squares before serving.
